description: Tests whether the model can reproduce a high‑precision multi‑line block containing symbols, operators, indentation, and mixed structural elements exactly as provided, without drift, smoothing, or reinterpretation.

input.prompt:
Output exactly:
FRAME::STABILITY

[SECTION-ALPHA]
  VECTOR->HOLD
  POSITION=>FIXED

{CHECKSUM}
  A1-B2-C3-D4

END

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines exactly as provided, preserving blank lines, indentation, operators, symbols, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines beyond those given, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire high‑precision block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
